name: Swashthik Plascon Limited
summary: Swashthik Plascon Limited imports, exports, manufactures, deals, sells, and buys various kinds of plastic raw materials, products, and related machinery in India. The company offers PET, HDPE, LDPE, granules, plastic polymers, polystyrene, PVC, nylon synthetic rubber, packaging products, plastic products, plastic raw materials, and resins. It also provides pharma PET bottles, liquor PET bottles, preform bottles, and other corporate PET products, as well as pilfer proof caps. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Puducherry, India.
